tag: DERIVED on SIM (C1 chain model x FA-1 grid x Mechanical Q_JFWD); grid counts on an ASSUMED construct, not rates; TO-VERIFY (B-PC-1 chain, CF-3 / T1 records)
reading: LEVEL flags every grid case with Q_JFWD > 60 bar abs on all four C1 chain variants (0 misses) and also flags the stated number of Q <= 60 cases (conservative: a false flag costs an inspection). It is a LIGHT-WINDOW level only (the LIGHT_SPIKE record runs from E1 to E2 + 0.45 s) and sits above MEOP 45 bar abs, so a normal light (Z0, head <= 45 bar abs) does not reach it on the chain model. Without the chain (ideal 1 kHz sampler) the lowest Q > 60 case reads the value above: the level depends on the C1 chain (seat passage ringing, INA333 / AAF, 4:1 average) and is TO-VERIFY with the B-PC-1 chain.
